# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release of Hookflare receives security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do **not** open a public issue for security problems.

Report vulnerabilities privately through
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/huongda-group/hookflare/security/advisories/new).
Include the affected version, a description of the issue, and steps to reproduce.

We aim to acknowledge reports within 3 business days and will coordinate a fix
and disclosure timeline with you.
